name: Empire's Blessing reduces the mana cost of Void Shield by 20% (#808)
contract: Empire's Blessing 704895 reads 'Reduces the mana cost of Void Shield by 20%.' In the installed Spell.dbc it is passive, family 31, effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER (108), misc 14 = SPELLMOD_COST, BasePoints -21 / DieSides 1 = -20%, class mask dword 1 = 536870912 = bit 29. Void Shield 500715 (family 31) carries SpellFamilyFlags[1] 536870912 (bit 29) -- exact match -- ManaCost 0 and ManaCostPercentage 26 (its real cost is 26% of max mana, verified directly). SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost (SpellInfo.cpp:3002-3077) computes powerCost = int32(CalculatePct(caster max mana, 26)) and only then applies modOwner->ApplySpellMod(Id, SPELLMOD_COST, powerCost, spell) at line 3077, so the PCT mod reduces the already-percentage-based cost rather than a separate flat ManaCost. Player::ApplySpellMod computes non-duration ops as base*totalmul+totalflat (Player.cpp:10324); with only the -20% PCT mod, cost*0.8. The scenario probes the raw cost op with a synthetic base and separately reads the live power cost of Void Shield itself before/after learning, asserting an 80% ratio (integer-rounding tolerance). Grasp of Zek'voz 573028 (family 31, SpellFamilyFlags dword 1 = 0) does not carry bit 29 and is the control.

steps.label: SETUP: Void Shield's cost op is unmodified
Void Shield's real live power cost before
Void Shield's cost op is now -20%
Grasp of Zek'voz is outside the mask
Void Shield's real live power cost drops to ~80% of the pre-talent cost
Void Shield's cost op returns to unmodified
